title: Infinity State Node Position Metadata (v1)
description: Optional visual placement metadata for SCJSON other_attributes.position on state-like nodes. Object coordinates are preferred; legacy string coordinates remain readable for compatibility. This schema is not part of core SCJSON validation.

x.description: Node x coordinate in canvas units.

y.description: Node y coordinate in canvas units.

LegacyPointString.description: Legacy coordinate string in the form "x,y".
